description: Builds a buy (or sell) of a pump.fun coin for the agent's own wallet: an unsigned Solana transaction (base64) with the pump.fun curve or PumpSwap trade and pumpdata's 0.4% fee inside it. pumpdata never holds a key: sign it with the wallet, then send it yourself or with send_tx. Expires in about a minute. For: buy this coin, ape 0.2 SOL, sell all.

sol.description: SOL to spend on a buy (0.001 to 100)

tokens.description: on a sell: raw token units, or "all"

wallet.description: the address that signs and pays

name: buy_coin
